name: Tacta

categories.label: Visible dots of your color
categories.labelVi: Số chấm còn nhìn thấy của màu mình
categories.hint: Count only dots of your own color still visible when the last card is played; the player on your right double-checks.

tiebreakers.description: Tied players share the victory; if a single winner is required, play again or the player who went out first wins.

notes: family: area-majority. Single round by default; groups may agree on several rounds or a target (suggested first to 100) and total the dots. Limited Space variant uses 3 rounds with one suit each and tallies dots from all rounds. Illegally placed cards found at scoring are removed, but dots connected to them still count.

sources.title: Tacta rules (The Op Games / USAopoly, 2025)
